description: Grade how discoverable a website is to AI answer engines (ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, Copilot and others) from its public files: robots.txt access for each major AI crawler (answer-engine vs training), sitemap.xml, plus llms.txt and ai.txt as informational signals. Returns an A-F grade, per-crawler access and findings.

domain.description: Website domain to grade, e.g. example.com

name: check_ai_discoverability
title: AI discoverability check (A-F grade)
